title: Remote Work Request Form
subtitle: Use this request to route the need, test readiness, document review, authorize a bounded action, and verify implementation for a remote work workflow.
description: An original operational remote work request form that controls a remote-work arrangement and operating-control record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the employee, manager, workplace, or remote-access coordinator needs a traceable request so the authorized HR, management, information-security, workplace, or payroll reviewer can approve, conditionally approve, trial, revise, suspend, deny, or close the remote-work arrangement under the current remote-work policy, role requirements, information-security standard, equipment rules, and applicable wage, safety, privacy, or accommodation process without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Remote Work request identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable request and identify the responsible reviewers before work begins.

blocks.label: Requested outcome, initiating event, business need, affected people or work, and explicit exclusions

sections.title: Requested remote work scope and operating need
sections.guidance: Describe the exact requested action and the evidence needed to evaluate it.

blocks.label: Remote Work request type
items: Recurring hybrid schedule with designated onsite days
Fully remote arrangement within an approved jurisdiction
Short-term remote period for a defined operational reason
Occasional remote day under manager discretion
Schedule, location, time-zone, or duration change
Cross-border, interstate, or other jurisdictional review
Remote-work trial with explicit success measures
Accommodation-related request routed through the confidential process

blocks.label: Operational reason, intended result, assumptions, dependencies, alternatives, and timing impact

sections.title: Remote Work readiness, policy, and impact review
sections.guidance: Confirm the request can be reviewed without bypassing privacy, safety, security, or authority controls.

blocks.label: Remote Work readiness checkpoints
items: Role outputs, onsite duties, customer coverage, and supervision needs are documented
Approved work location, jurisdiction, schedule, time zone, and availability are complete
HR, payroll, tax, legal, or labor routing is complete where required
Organization-managed device and approved remote-access method are identified
Multi-factor authentication, updates, encryption, and screen-lock controls are confirmed
Data classification, storage, printing, disposal, and private-conversation controls are understood
Home or alternate network and workspace meet the organization's stated requirements
Timekeeping, breaks, overtime, absence, and schedule-change procedures are clear
Equipment, support, expense, internet, travel, and return duties are assigned
Security, privacy, injury, equipment, and connectivity incident routes are known
Continuity fallback and required onsite response are practical
Trial measures, review date, change conditions, and closeout route are documented

blocks.label: Request and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This request does not itself authorize action. The authorized HR, management, information-security, workplace, or payroll reviewer must apply the current remote-work policy, role requirements, information-security standard, equipment rules, and applicable wage, safety, privacy, or accommodation process, resolve exceptions, and record any conditions before implementation.

sections.title: Remote Work review, alternatives, and decision
sections.guidance: Compare the request to the governing evidence and document why the selected route is appropriate.

blocks.label: Requirement, evidence, finding, and decision matrix
Evidence considered, alternatives rejected, approved limits, exception treatment, and communication plan

sections.title: Approved remote work implementation and exception handoff
sections.guidance: Translate the decision into owned work without losing a condition or system update.

blocks.label: Approved action, condition, system update, and completion evidence
Implementation and communication controls
items: Role and coverage remain workable under the proposed arrangement
Location, jurisdiction, schedule, and duration received required review
Information-security and privacy controls match the work and data
Timekeeping, overtime, expense, travel, and equipment duties are explicit
Connectivity and business-continuity fallback is sufficient
Accommodation details remain outside the general arrangement record
Trial metrics and review date support an evidence-based decision
Modification, suspension, onsite return, and closeout authority are clear

blocks.label: Implementation variance, failed dependency, changed fact, immediate action, and reapproval need

sections.title: Remote Work request completion and closeout
sections.guidance: Close only when the implemented result, remaining limits, and receiving ownership are verifiable.

blocks.label: Open remote work action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance

fields.label: Authorized Hr, Management, Information-Security, Workplace, Or Payroll Reviewer / date
